assumptions: Displayed source centres used as exact illustrative inputs
Retire at beginning, depreciate surviving assets, acquire at year end; no other PP&E movements
Cash payments all for current additions, no opening capital payables, no disposal proceeds; additional purchases unpaid
All depreciation treated as expense in this subsystem; tax, OCI and owner flows omitted; no probability weights
Extra acquired and retired cost belong to the same gross PP&E class.
The two liabilities share the same Note 6 non-tax bucket.
Lease quantities, shares and commitments are held fixed; no offset is assigned to their separately disclosed populations.
Current/deferred tax bases and expense match; equal pretax profit alone does not establish this.
Condition on an admissible base that is not constructed here.
Inherited q=2000 is illustrative; capital/expense mapping is unadmitted.
Amounts settle at carrying value with sufficient unrestricted cash assumed; no financing event is invented.
Capital payments classified investing; expense settlements operating.
All other activities fixed for the local difference test; taxes/FX/interest/remeasurement have zero incremental effects.
These are ex post scenarios without probability, not historical as-of forecasts.
Retirement loss and the distinct expense both map to operations.products_cost. Capital payable and expense liability both map to balance.other_liabilities_current, a non-tax bucket.

All other report primitives, shares, distributions and OCI remain fixed; current and deferred tax match. Alpha allocates the expense-liability change once between cash_flow.other_adjustments and cash_flow.other_liabilities.
